verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs explicitly describe agents that analyze requirements, fix bugs, write tests, run/test changes in isolated environments, and integrate with issue trackers (Jira/Linear) and CI/CD to trigger fixes on build failures, covering the diagnose-and-fix workflow autonomously. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of a real bug being diagnosed and fixed end-to-end, and detail on how root-cause diagnosis (vs. just prompted fixes) is performed.
